name: China Tile Map
summary: Compliance-safe China cartogram: the 34 provincial-level divisions as equal-size squares or hexagons on a geography-like grid, shaded by a metric — no boundaries, so no map-review (审图号) issue in client decks.
summary_zh: 合规友好的中国省级方块地图：34 个省级行政区各占一个等大的方块（或六边形），按近似地理位置排布并按指标着色；不绘制任何边界线，客户材料中无需审图号。
description_zh: 用于在客户材料中展示按省汇总的指标（收入、增速、门店数、市场份额）。每个省级行政区（含台湾、香港、澳门）是一个同样大小的方块，按地理相对位置排成 7 × 8 网格：黑龙江在右上，新疆、西藏在左侧，长江沿线（西藏—四川—重庆—湖北—安徽—江苏—上海）占一整行，海南在底部，港澳在广东下方，台湾在福建东侧。因为不画边界、不涉及比例尺和领土轮廓，图表不属于需要送审的“地图”，也不会因边界画法引发合规问题；同时每个省面积相等，避免新疆、西藏等大省在视觉上压倒东部经济大省。数据可按 6 位行政区划代码（adcode，市/县级代码自动汇总到省）、中文或英文省名（带不带“省/市/自治区”均可）或 ISO 3166-2:CN 字母代码连接。方块颜色表示数值：顺序色阶或以中点为中心的发散色阶（如增速相对集团平均），默认按分位数分 5 档并取整为好看的分界值，图例显示每档省份数；也可用等距分档或连续色阶。方块上显示中文简称或英文名/代码，空间足够时第二行显示格式化数值；可用强调色描边突出重点省份。悬停显示全部字段和排名，点击方块交叉筛选其他图表，悬停图例高亮该档省份、点击图例按档筛选；筛选变化时颜色平滑过渡。
best_for: Revenue / stores / headcount by province for China-client decks (no 审图号 needed)
Growth vs. a group average by province (diverging around the average)
Provincial footprint where area-based maps would over-weight Xinjiang / Tibet / Inner Mongolia
Small, print-safe national overview next to a table or commentary
avoid_when: Exact geography matters (distances, routes, city locations) — use bubble-map with an approved basemap
City- or county-level detail (tiles are provincial; city adcodes roll up to their province)
Precise comparison of close values — pair with a bar chart or table

id.desc: Province key: 6-digit adcode ("440000"; city / county codes roll up), Chinese or English name ("广东省", "广东", "Guangdong") or ISO 3166-2:CN letters ("GD", "CN-GD")

value.desc: Metric that drives the tile colour (several rows per province are combined with options.agg)

join.desc: auto | adcode | name — how encode.id values are matched (name also accepts ISO letters); unmatched keys are reported once in the console

lang.desc: Tile labels: 'zh' (北京, or 简称 京 on small tiles) | 'en' (Beijing, or ISO letters BJ on small tiles)

labels.desc: auto (short name when it fits every tile, else 简称 / ISO code) | name | abbr | false

values.desc: Second line with the formatted value: auto (when tiles are large enough) | true | false

shape.desc: square | hex (pointy-top hexagons, odd rows offset half a tile)

scale.desc: auto (diverging when values straddle mid) | sequential | diverging

mid.desc: Diverging midpoint (0 for growth, or e.g. the group average)

bins.desc: Number of colour classes; 0 = continuous ramp. Diverging uses symmetric nice steps around mid (classes per side = bins / 2)

classify.desc: quantile | equal — how sequential class breaks are found (then rounded to nice numbers)

breaks.desc: Explicit class breaks, e.g. [5, 10, 20, 40] (overrides bins / classify)

format.desc: Value format for tiles, legend and tooltip; defaults to the value field format

agg.desc: Combine several rows per province: sum | avg | max | min | median | first

highlight.desc: Province key(s) outlined in the accent colour (adcode, name or ISO letters), e.g. the target's home province

highlightLabel.desc: Legend entry explaining the highlight outline (e.g. "Headquarters")

tooltip.desc: 'all' lists every field of the row (province name / code columns go to the title), or an array of fields, or false

legend.desc: Colour legend with province counts per class; hover a class to focus its tiles, click it to cross-filter them

legendTitle.desc: Legend title; defaults to the value field title and unit

legendPosition.desc: auto (the empty top-left corner of the grid when it fits, else beside or below) | corner | left | right | bottom

filterField.desc: Field used for click-to-filter; defaults to encode.id. 'province' (a shared dimension) filters the whole report; other fields such as adcode only this block's dataset — set crossFilterScope to override

gap.desc: Gap between tiles in px (default about 6% of the cell, 2–5 px)

layout.desc: Position overrides {key: [row, col]}, keys as for encode.id (e.g. {"TW": [5, 6]})

note.desc: Small schematic disclaimer drawn in the free bottom-right corner (true: 'Schematic; no boundaries implied' / '示意图，不代表实际边界'), or your own text

uiLang.desc: Language of legend / tooltip UI strings ('zh' | 'en'); defaults to the report locale or <html lang>, independent of the tile-label language

interactions: Hover a tile: tooltip with names, value, rank and every other field
Click a tile to cross-filter (others dim; shared dimensions such as province filter the report, other fields this dataset only)
Hover a legend class to focus its tiles; click it to cross-filter the whole class
Animated colour transitions when filters change; staggered west-to-east entrance
PNG / SVG export including the legend; print-safe (no animation, SVG)
